What We Do

Our Roofing Services

From a few slipped tiles to a complete re-roof, plus the fascias, soffits and guttering around it.

Re-Roofs and New Roofs

Old coverings stripped back and the roof re-tiled or re-slated from the battens up, so it stays sound and dry.

Get a quote

Dry Ridge and Verge

Mechanically fixed ridge and verge systems that replace crumbling mortar and keep the weather out.

Get a quote

Flat Roofs

GRP and EPDM rubber flat roofs for extensions, porches, garages and dormers, laid to shed water properly.

Get a quote

Fascias and Soffits

Rotten timber boards replaced with low-maintenance uPVC fascias and soffits that keep their finish.

Get a quote

Guttering and Downpipes

New gutters and downpipes fitted, and blocked ones cleared out, so rainwater goes where it should.

Get a quote

Roof Repairs

Slipped or cracked tiles, leaks, flashings and storm damage found and put right before it spreads.

Get a quote

About Us

The Team Behind Correct Way Roofing

Correct Way Roofing and General Building is run by Dean, a roofer based in Telford. The name says how the work is done: properly and first time, whether it is a few slipped tiles or a whole new roof.

Customers mention the same things again and again: the job is explained clearly, the price is fair and the site is left tidy. Dean will even track down tiles that match the ones already on the roof, so a repair does not stand out.

DeanOwner, Correct Way Roofing & General Building
